column1: # tools/mutation/canaries.tsv: mutants the nightly runs every night (run_mutants.py --canaries) that only one
# oracle executable can kill. A canary that survives, or dies to another executable, fails the night: it
# says that executable has left the oracle or the check that kills it is gone. Columns, tab-separated:
# file, the line's text, the mutated line's text, the executable that must kill it, the check that does.
